message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crimes. Facts: defendant drove car with fake base station equipment, in three districts, impersonated Construction Bank customer service, sent 7129 fraudulent SMS messages. This is fraud via telecom (短信诈骗). Likely crime: "诈骗罪" (fraud). Also possibly "非法利用信息网络罪"? In Chinese criminal law, sending fraudulent SMS is "诈骗罪" (fraud) under article 266. Also using fake base station equipment may be "非法设立、使用专用电信设施罪"? But the main is fraud. The instruction: when listing crime name(s) between [罪名] and <eoa>, output only statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we should output "诈骗". If multiple, separate with semicolons. Here only one. So final answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>. Provide JSON with reasoning and final_answer.
